ch: This is Feedback Studio, for anyone who builds apps, and anyone who tests them.
How it works: the app you are testing opens right here in the window, working for real.
The benefit: honest feedback in five minutes, instead of a meeting nobody schedules.
But by the time they sit down to write about it, half of it is gone.
And Comments, with a number, opens your list.
How to start, in your first two minutes.
Using Feedback Studio for the first time.
Step two: press the big red button.
Step six: tap Comments to see everything you said.
